title: My Dream Diary: Published:
content: I did a dumb thing and self-published my dream diary. (20’-22’) I didn’t offer a Kindle version yet, so for now only paperback. It was a tough two years deciding to go through with this - the words in my book make my mental state look questionable. It’s one of the reasons not to publish personal stuff. When I first arrived to this Reddit - I was surprised by how similar the dreams everyone was writing about, were to my own. This book wasn’t written by AI nor copied from the various dream Reddit’s… my social media friends can vouch for seeing my posts in 2020-2024. I have since shut-down my blog in order to publish the book. My introduction sections and first two chapters
